detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
For The End of Bipolarity (Disintegration of Second World & Collapse of Bipolarity):
In March 1985, Mikhail Gorbachev was chosen as the General Secretary of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union. Therefore, option (D) is the correct answer.
